page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-standard-4 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the c4a server family. It is powered by an arm64 CPU architecture, featuring 4 dedicated virtual central processing units (vCPUs) and 16.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage or bundled graphics processing units, relying instead on network-attached storage options for persistent disk requirements. It also does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The arm64 architecture offers a power-efficient alternative to traditional x86-64 platforms, providing a cost-effective profile for workloads optimized for ARM instruction sets.

The c4a-standard-4 is designed for general-purpose workloads. Suitable use cases include web serving, microservices, containerized applications, development environments, and lightweight database instances that benefit from dedicated CPU resources and a balanced memory footprint.
